newsitem.title: THAILAND: Slow Thai economy needs time to recover -Amnuay.
newsitem.headline: Slow Thai economy needs time to recover -Amnuay.

text.p: Thai Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan said on Monday that the sluggish Thai economy was stabilising now but more time would be needed for a recovery.
It would take some time to solve the current problems weighing down Thailand, Amnuay said.

"The economy has improved but it needs more time to recover. It won't take a day or two to solve all the problems," Amnuay said. "If you look at economic history of other countries, you'll see that is the case."

Thailand is faced with a slowing economy hit by turmoil in the financial sector where banks and finance firms are saddled with billions of dollars in bad loans to the depressed property sector. Rescue measures have been launched for both sectors by the authorities.
Thailand's exports growth has contracted and the private investment and manufacturing indexes have also slowed.
Official predictions are that the Thai economy will grow by 6.8 percent this year but private analysts expect it to be below six percent.
